executive_summary: Maven build failed with 100 compilation errors across test files. Primary issues include missing service methods (getColumnStats, bulkUpdateColumnCounts, getTaskDetails), type incompatibilities between String and Long for IDs, and DTO method mismatches. These errors indicate incomplete implementation of service interfaces and DTOs that don't match the test expectations.

errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface is missing the getColumnStats() method that tests are trying to call
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getColumnStats(String columnId) method to ColumnService interface and implement it in ColumnServiceImpl

errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface is missing the bulkUpdateColumnCounts() method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add bulkUpdateColumnCounts(BulkUpdateColumnCountsRequest request) method to ColumnService interface and implement it in ColumnServiceImpl

errors.message: incompatible types: inference variable T has incompatible bounds (upper: Long, lower: String)
errors.root_cause: Task ID type mismatch - tests use String but service expects Long
errors.fix_recommendation: Update Task entity and related DTOs to use Long for ID fields consistently, or update tests to use String if that's the intended design

errors.message: incompatible types: java.lang.String cannot be converted to java.lang.Long
errors.root_cause: Task ID type mismatch in test setup
errors.fix_recommendation: Change task ID from String to Long in test data setup or update Task entity to use String IDs

errors.message: incompatible types: TaskStatus cannot be converted to java.lang.String
errors.root_cause: TaskStatus enum is being used where String is expected in DTO
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskDetailsResponse to accept TaskStatus enum instead of String, or convert enum to String in the response builder

errors.root_cause: TaskDetailsResponse DTO is missing setColumnId() method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setColumnId(String columnId) method to TaskDetailsResponse DTO or use builder pattern with columnId field

errors.root_cause: TaskService interface is missing getTaskDetails() method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getTaskDetails(String taskId) method to TaskService interface and implement it in TaskServiceImpl

errors.message: incompatible types: TaskPriority cannot be converted to TaskCreateRequest.TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: Enum type mismatch - TaskPriority exists in two different locations
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate TaskPriority enum into a single shared location (e.g., models/enums) and remove duplicate from TaskCreateRequest

errors.root_cause: TaskResponse DTO is missing setVersion() method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setVersion(long version) method to TaskResponse DTO or include version field in builder pattern

errors.root_cause: PagedTaskResponse DTO is missing setLast() method for pagination
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setLast(boolean last) method to PagedTaskResponse DTO to indicate last page in pagination

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types (required: Long,int,int found: Long,int,int,String)
errors.root_cause: getUserTasks() method signature mismatch - tests pass 4 parameters but method accepts only 3
errors.fix_recommendation: Add status filter parameter to getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size, String status) method in TaskService interface

errors.root_cause: BulkTaskResponse DTO is missing setCreatedTasks() method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setCreatedTasks(List<TaskResponse> tasks) method to BulkTaskResponse DTO or use builder pattern with createdTasks field

summary: 12 grouped compilation errors found across test files
